source: Completed normal Will version4 battle log, 2026-10-02_00-23-14; public installed team data. Do not read live AI logs.
core_plan: Arcanine lead applies Intimidate. Switch Mienshao, Fake Out then High Jump Kick; accept miss without restoring save.

If Mienshao faints, Swampert uses Earthquake. Do not try to outheal Torrent Aqua Tail with 120HP Hyper Potions. If Swampert faints after two EQs, free Arcanine Extreme Speed finishes the remaining42HP.

Gardevoir free change to Ampharos: Light Screen, Thunder Wave. Then paid switch Klinklang; observed AI selected Hyper Voice against Ampharos, which Klinklang resists under screen. At80 one Gear Grind likely KOs Gardevoir. Check actual HP/move after switch.

Charizard facing Klinklang: use one Hyper Potion on stored Ampharos (~83->203HP) while Klinklang absorbs the attack. If Klinklang faints, Ampharos can Thunder Wave then Discharge; Arcanine priority can finish if Ampharos falls.
Sceptile: Arcanine Flamethrower, Morning Sun when safe. Adapt ordering and critical hits from UI.
limits: Not a rigid guarantee. Stop helper on unexpected actor/foe, immunity, lowHP or resource prompt. Failed attempts stay in fulljourney. Ordinary practice fight excluded frommajor.
